title: When elephants play cricket, even a stumping turns into a celebration! 🐘🏏#YouTube shors#Fun cricket
description:
Description
A playful herd of elephants takes the cricket field! The bowler delivers a perfect ball, the batsman misses, and the wicketkeeper stumps him cleanly. The batsman walks back sadly while the fielders rush to celebrate—hugging the bowler with their tusks and dancing with joy. A fun reminder that sports are not just about winning, but about the joy of the game.
